summary: Backend-only testing of new map customization upload endpoints (POST /api/settings/upload-pin-icon, POST /api/settings/upload-map-bg) and the updated /api/settings/public payload. Created /app/backend/tests/test_map_uploads.py with 12 pytest cases covering happy path, persistence, static-file serving, content-type validation, anonymous and customer (non-admin) auth rejection, and map_bg_size/map_bg_position persistence via POST /api/settings/. All 12 tests pass (100%).

minor.issue: No max-size cap (review_request mentions 'pin no limit' so this is intentional, but a sane cap e.g. 2MB would be safer to prevent disk-fill DoS)
Old files are never cleaned up from /app/backend/uploads when settings are overwritten — orphaned image files accumulate on disk.
Content-type is trusted from the multipart header; the file bytes themselves are not validated (a renamed .png containing arbitrary data would pass).

action_items: Optional: add a max file size for pin uploads (e.g. 2MB) and content-bytes sniffing for both endpoints.
Optional: delete the previously-stored map_bg_image_url / custom_pin_url file from disk when overwritten to prevent orphaned files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2049 lines — should be split into modules (settings, auth, admin, orders) for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
Allowed types are inferred from the request Content-Type header only. Consider validating file magic bytes for image uploads.
Uploaded filenames use uuid4 hex[:8] (32 bits) — collisions are unlikely but possible; consider hex[:16].
Old uploaded files are never deleted when settings are updated → disk leak over time.
test_credentials: admin@taxi.local / admin123 (admin login OK); customer +79001234567 with test code 1234 in test_mode (OK)
seed_data_creation: None. Test uploads create transient files under /app/backend/uploads (pin_icon_*, map_bg_*); map_bg_size/map_bg_position are restored to cover/center after the persistence test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable suite at /app/backend/tests/test_map_uploads.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set). Covers: public settings shape, pin icon upload (PNG+SVG), map bg upload (PNG, SVG rejection), text/plain rejection, anonymous + customer auth rejection, and map_bg_size/position persistence. Note: settings save endpoint is POST /api/settings/ (NOT PUT /api/admin/settings as the review_request hinted). Customer OTP login requires device_id and uses /auth/send-code & /auth/verify-code (not /auth/request-otp).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All 12 backend tests passed.
